editorial.blurb: A warm, authentic German beer hall that captures the jolly spirit of a small Kneipe, with hearty food and an exceptional rotating selection of German brews.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weekday for a more relaxed experience, order the half pretzel (even for two people, the full is massive), and ask staff about their current Oktoberfest selections—they typically have 11+ German beers on draft.
signatureDishes: smorgasbord with sausages and pickled vegetables
